row.title: Cloudflare and main writes go through the Workers, not GitHub secrets (CF-ROUTE-1, MAIN-WRITER-PR-1)
row.body: The Cloudflare secret in GitHub Actions is not the credential the platform deploys with: deploys use the site Worker's own token through an OIDC route. The credential check, the backup drill and the runway therefore read the account through the site Worker's allow-listed /__internal/cf route (GET d1/kv, SELECT-only queries, backup-prefix R2 writes). The GitHub secret and LANE_PAT are optional and no longer limit the runway. When the ruleset refuses the org App a direct write to main, the tick Worker opens a pull request with the App, which starts checks, instead of answering 409.
